speaker: Castle
direction: Jangala arrival (storyboard-v3.md). Shots C1-C2: the passengers overhear the bridge on an open cabin intercom. Jangala Approach is a Hegemony traffic controller across orbit, heavily masked by orbital_comms; Castle is on the bridge microphone, heard through the intercom (comms). Entry to C5 (jangala_arrival_castle_*, owner's script of 2026-10-19, arrival-audio/sfx-cues.md): Castle speaks to the Commander through the intercom (comms), once to the whole ship over the loudspeaker heard from the yard (ship_pa), and last beside the Commander, unprocessed (clean). lines.speaker: Jangala Approach
lines.text: Cerberus on the inbound lane, this is Jangala Approach. Your transponder reads a decommissioned mining escort. State your business in Corvus.
lines.synthesisText: [relaxed, professional air-traffic controller] Cerberus on the inbound lane, this is Jangala Approach. Your transponder reads a decommissioned mining escort. State your business in Corvus.

lines.speaker: Castle
lines.text: Jangala Approach, this is Second Wind. Civilian. Crew and families aboard, nothing for sale. We're expected at Greywater Down, private cradle Kilo Nine.
lines.synthesisText: [steady, careful voice] Jangala Approach, this is Second Wind. Civilian. Crew and families aboard, nothing for sale. We're expected at Greywater Down, private cradle Kilo Nine.

lines.speaker: Jangala Approach
lines.text: Corvus is under Hegemony customs. Declare any AI cores, harvested organs, recreational drugs or heavy armaments.
lines.synthesisText: [relaxed, professional air-traffic controller, reading a routine checklist] Corvus is under Hegemony customs. Declare any A.I. cores, harvested organs, recreational drugs, or heavy armaments.

lines.speaker: Castle
lines.text: Nothing to declare, Approach. Ore dust and tired people.
lines.synthesisText: [dry, tired, understated voice] Nothing to declare, Approach. Ore dust, and tired people.

lines.speaker: Jangala Approach
lines.text: Second Wind, you're cleared to Greywater Down on civilian corridor four. Keep your mounts cold and stay in the corridor. Patrol has your signature.
lines.synthesisText: [relaxed, professional air-traffic controller] Second Wind, you're cleared to Greywater Down on civilian corridor four. Keep your mounts cold, and stay in the corridor. Patrol has your signature.

lines.speaker: Castle
lines.text: Corridor four, mounts cold. Thank you, Approach.
lines.synthesisText: [relieved, quiet voice] Corridor four, mounts cold. Thank you, Approach.

lines.speaker: Castle
lines.text: We've got a few days planetside before we'll need to move along, Commander.
lines.synthesisText: [calm, steady, dry, to the Commander beside her] We've got a few days planetside before we'll need to move along, Commander.

lines.speaker: Castle
lines.text: So much greenery and life... it's like the travel reels from the canteen.
lines.synthesisText: [quiet, a little wonder under the words, looking out of the window] So much greenery and life... it's like the travel reels from the canteen.

lines.speaker: Castle
lines.text: Set us down in that fenced yard on the east side. Nessa called in a favour to get us a berth for refit. Best behaviour.
lines.synthesisText: [calm, practical, a small dry smile at the end] Set us down in that fenced yard on the east side. Nessa called in a favour to get us a berth for refit. Best behaviour.

lines.speaker: Castle
lines.text: All hands, get some rest, see the sights, but keep your identification on you. We regroup at the yard tomorrow.
lines.synthesisText: [calm, confident, warm ship's announcement, a captain in control] All hands, get some rest, see the sights, but keep your identification on you. We regroup at the yard tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Castle
lines.text: Hard part starts now, Commander. From here, we find our own way.
lines.synthesisText: [quiet, resolute, confident, looking ahead, to one person] Hard part starts now, Commander. From here, we find our own way.
